title: Quaint Creamy Croatian Fish Stew
description: A salty, creamy, and cozy Croatian dish featuring sazon and soffritto base, perfect for a cold evening, this gluten-free-friendly stew is made with fresh fish and vegetables.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cod fish and cook until it is opaque and flakes easily with a fork, about 5 minutes.
Add the sazon seasoning, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
